_note: Jurisdiction routing table. Hand-authored from constitutional and statutory sources; see README. The router selects a domain, then (if the domain has a disambiguator) one option. Never more than two questions.

disambiguator.question: What kind of road is it?
disambiguator.hint: If you are not sure, pick the closest — we will say what we assumed.

options.label: A road inside a village
options.reason: A village road is the Panchayat’s job, so this does not go to Delhi.
options.legal_basis: Article 243G and the Eleventh Schedule; local government is Entry 5 of the State List
options.fallback: There is no online system for Panchayat roads anywhere in India. The honest way in is the state CM helpline, filled in for you.

options.label: A rural road built under PMGSY
options.reason: PMGSY roads are checked by their own team, under the Ministry of Rural Development.
options.legal_basis: A central government scheme, not a law

options.label: A street inside a town or city
options.reason: Roads and bridges are the municipality’s job.
options.legal_basis: Article 243W and the Twelfth Schedule; Entry 5, State List
options.fallback: City portals differ. Where none exists we degrade to the state portal and say so.

options.label: A state highway or a big district road
options.office: Executive Engineer, State Public Works Department
options.reason: Roads other than national highways are a State subject.

options.label: A national highway
options.reason: National highways are a Union subject, so this one genuinely does go to Delhi.
options.legal_basis: Entry 23, Union List; National Highways Act 1956; NHAI Act 1988

options.label: Inside a cantonment
options.reason: Cantonment roads sit with the Cantonment Board under the Ministry of Defence.

asks.q: How long has it been like this, and what has it stopped?
asks.hint: A rough answer is fine. Say if an ambulance, a school van or a delivery cannot get through.
asks.ph: Example: since the first rain, the school van will not come

asks.q: Which stretch is worst, and has anyone been hurt on it?
asks.hint: A landmark is enough. The school turning, the handpump, the bus stop.
asks.ph: Example: the forty metres before the school gate

identifiers.label: The road or stretch
identifiers.hint: A name, or the landmark at each end.

identifiers.label: How long it has been like this
identifiers.hint: A month is enough.

infra.water.label: Water supply
infra.water.reason: Water supply is a local body subject, so it is decided at your ward, not centrally.
infra.water.legal_basis: Twelfth Schedule (water supply for domestic, industrial and commercial purposes); Eleventh Schedule for rural drinking water

asks.q: How many days has the supply been off, and at what hours does it come?
asks.hint: And where you are getting water meanwhile. A tanker, a neighbour, purchased cans.
asks.ph: Example: four days a week, nothing after 7 am

asks.q: How many houses around you are affected?
asks.hint: A rough count is enough. It decides whether this is one connection or the whole line.
asks.ph: Example: the whole lane, about twenty houses

identifiers.label: Your consumer number
identifiers.hint: On your water bill, if you get one. Skip it if you do not.

identifiers.label: Since when
identifiers.hint: Roughly how long the supply has been failing.

infra.power.label: Electricity — outage or wrong bill
infra.power.reason: Your electricity company answers first, and the law puts a forum above it if they do not.

asks.q: How many hours a day is the supply out?
asks.hint: Give the worst stretch you have had this week.
asks.ph: Example: nine hours, mostly 6 pm to 3 am

asks.q: Has the outage damaged anything or stopped work?
asks.hint: A burnt appliance, spoiled stock, a shop or a clinic that had to close. Say no if not.
asks.ph: Example: the fridge compressor burnt

identifiers.label: Your consumer number
identifiers.hint: On your electricity bill — not your bank account number.

identifiers.label: Since when
identifiers.hint: When the outage or the wrong billing started.

money.pf.label: Provident fund — EPFO
money.pf.reason: EPFO handles this through its own grievance system before anything else.

identifiers.label: Your UAN
identifiers.hint: 12 digits, on your payslip or the EPFO app.

identifiers.label: When you filed the claim
identifiers.hint: Approximate month is fine.

asks.q: What is your UAN, and which claim is stuck?
asks.hint: The UAN lets the regional office pull up the file without asking you again. Name the form, 19, 10C or 31, if you know it.
asks.ph: Example: UAN 1012 3456 7890, Form 19

asks.q: When did you file it, and has the office asked you for anything since?
asks.hint: A KYC query, a rejection, or complete silence. Each one changes the next step.
asks.ph: Example: filed in June, complete silence

money.tax_refund.label: Income tax refund
money.tax_refund.office: Centralised Processing Centre, Income Tax Department
money.tax_refund.reason: The processing centre handles refund delays, and the law says you get interest on the delay.

identifiers.label: Assessment year
identifiers.hint: For example 2025-26.

identifiers.label: Date you filed the return
identifiers.hint: Approximate is fine.

asks.q: Which assessment year is this, and when did you file?
asks.hint: The assessment year and the filing date decide which office holds your case.
asks.ph: Example: AY 2025-26, filed 12 July

asks.q: What does the portal show, a status, a demand, or nothing?
asks.hint: Under processing, refund failed, a demand notice, or no movement at all.
asks.ph: Example: still says under processing

money.bank.label: Bank, payment or fraud
money.bank.reason: Your bank gets 30 days first. After that an ombudsman can hear it.
money.bank.legal_basis: Reserve Bank of India Act 1934; RB-IOS 2021

identifiers.label: Which bank
identifiers.hint: Bank name is enough.

identifiers.label: When you first complained to the bank
identifiers.hint: This decides whether the ombudsman can hear it yet.

asks.q: What was the amount, the date, and which bank?
asks.hint: A disputed debit can only be traced with the amount and date. Add the reference from your statement if you have it.
asks.ph: Example: 18,400 on 11 August, SBI Madhubani

asks.q: Have you complained to the bank already, and when?
asks.hint: That date is the one the Ombudsman clock runs from. Say no if this is the first time.
asks.ph: Example: yes, on 18 August, no reply since

supply.ration.label: Ration or PDS
supply.ration.office: District Grievance Redressal Officer under the NFSA
supply.ration.reason: The NFSA gives every district a grievance officer for exactly this.
supply.ration.legal_basis: National Food Security Act 2013, sections 14, 15 and 16
supply.ration.note: One report can make two cases: a private one about what you are owed, and a shared one about the shop that neighbours can join.

asks.q: What were you refused, and in which month?
asks.hint: What the dealer said, and how much you were owed.
asks.ph: Example: no wheat for two months, he said stock is over

asks.q: How many people are in the household?
asks.hint: The household count decides the quantity you are owed each month.
asks.ph: Example: five, including two children

identifiers.label: The ration shop
identifiers.hint: Its name, its number, or where it is.

identifiers.label: Which month you were refused
identifiers.hint: The most recent one will do.

identifiers.label: People in your household
identifiers.hint: This decides the quantity you are owed.

work.mgnrega.label: MGNREGA work or wages
work.mgnrega.reason: MGNREGA has a district ombudsperson with power to pass awards.
work.mgnrega.legal_basis: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act 2005

asks.q: How many days did you work, and when were the wages due?
asks.hint: Wages are due within fifteen days of the work. That date starts the compensation clock.
asks.ph: Example: fourteen days in July, nothing since

asks.q: Did you ask for work in writing, or was it spoken?
asks.hint: A written demand is what makes an unemployment allowance claimable.
asks.ph: Example: asked the rozgar sevak, nothing on paper

identifiers.label: Your MGNREGA job card
identifiers.hint: The number on the card. It is not a bank or debit card.

identifiers.label: The days you worked
identifiers.hint: The weeks or the muster roll dates, roughly.

money.pmkisan.label: PM-KISAN instalment
money.pmkisan.reason: Simple portal problems are fixed at the first level. Land records and eligibility go up to the senior state officer for the scheme.
money.pmkisan.legal_basis: Central scheme of the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

asks.q: Which instalment did not come, and what does the portal say?
asks.hint: The status line matters. Land seeding pending, eKYC pending, or a bank failure.
asks.ph: Example: the 22nd, it says land seeding pending

asks.q: Is the name the same on your land record, your Aadhaar and your passbook?
asks.hint: Do not type the numbers. Just tell me whether the names match.
asks.ph: Example: the passbook has my father name, the land record has mine

identifiers.label: Your PM-KISAN registration number
identifiers.hint: From the portal or your acknowledgement slip.

identifiers.label: Which instalment is missing
identifiers.hint: For example, the one due in April.

property.housing.label: Builder, flat or property paper
property.housing.reason: RERA has an officer who can order the builder to pay you, and has to decide within 60 days.

asks.q: Which project is it, and what were you promised in writing?
asks.hint: The handover date in the agreement is what a RERA clock runs from.
asks.ph: Example: possession was due December 2024

asks.q: Have you written to the builder, and did they reply?
asks.hint: A written attempt is what the authority will ask for first.
asks.ph: Example: emailed twice, no reply

identifiers.label: The project and the builder
identifiers.hint: The name on your agreement.

identifiers.label: The RERA registration number
identifiers.hint: On the builder’s hoarding or the agreement. Skip if you do not have it.

identifiers.label: The handover date you were promised
identifiers.hint: From the agreement.

travel.rail.label: Train or station
travel.rail.reason: RailMadad and helpline 139 handle this, and CPGRAMS really is the right place above them. We say so instead of pretending we are better.

asks.q: What is your PNR, and the train and date of travel?
asks.hint: The PNR lets the divisional office pull up the booking without asking you again.
asks.ph: Example: PNR 4412887654, train 12554 on 9 August

asks.q: What are you asking for, a refund or an answer?
asks.hint: A refund claim and a service complaint go to different desks in the same division.
asks.ph: Example: a refund for the meal that never came

identifiers.label: Your PNR
identifiers.hint: 10 digits on the ticket. It is not a payment number.

telecom.service.label: Phone or internet
telecom.service.reason: TRAI requires a two-tier mechanism inside the operator. There is no telecom ombudsman.
telecom.service.legal_basis: TRAI Act 1997; Telecom Consumers Protection Regulations

asks.q: Which operator, and what exactly is wrong?
asks.hint: A wrong charge, no signal, or a service you did not ask for.
asks.ph: Example: charged 199 for a pack I never took

asks.q: Have you complained to them, and did they give you a docket number?
asks.hint: That number is the first thing an appeal officer will ask you for.
asks.ph: Example: yes, docket 8891234, nothing since

identifiers.label: The docket number the operator gave you
identifiers.hint: From the SMS or email when you first complained.

identifiers.label: When you first complained to them
identifiers.hint: This decides when you can go above them.

office.inaction.label: An office is not doing its work
office.inaction.office: The grievance officer of the department concerned
office.inaction.reason: We route to the department's own grievance officer and start the clock.
office.inaction.legal_basis: A government instruction of 23 August 2024 — an internal rule, not a law

asks.q: Which office, and what were you there for?
asks.hint: The block office, a bank, a school, a hospital. And what you needed from them.
asks.ph: Example: the tehsil office, for a caste certificate

asks.q: How many times have you been, and what did they say the last time?
asks.hint: Come tomorrow, the sahib is not here, or nothing at all.
asks.ph: Example: four visits, they keep saying come next week

identifiers.label: Your application or file number
identifiers.hint: From the receipt or acknowledgement. Not an account number.

identifiers.label: When you applied
identifiers.hint: Approximate month is fine.

integrity.bribe.label: Someone demanded money from me
integrity.bribe.office: Chief Vigilance Officer of the department concerned
integrity.bribe.reason: Corruption complaints leave the ordinary grievance workflow.
integrity.bribe.warning: Bribery complaints go to the Vigilance Officer under CVC rules. You will get one acknowledgement and then no updates, and no Action Taken Report is filed. That is the rule, not neglect. You can file with your name withheld from the office.

asks.q: What was asked for, by whom, and for which service?
asks.hint: A designation is enough if you do not have a name. Do not put in anything you are not willing to have on record.
asks.ph: Example: the clerk at the block office wanted 2,000 to move my file

asks.q: When did this happen, and has it happened more than once?
asks.hint: A repeat on record is what moves a vigilance file.
asks.ph: Example: twice, in June and again last week

identifiers.label: Which office
identifiers.hint: The office and the town. Only what you are willing to have on record.

identifiers.label: What you were trying to get
identifiers.hint: The certificate, licence or service.

other.label: Something else
other.reason: We could not place this confidently, so we will say what we are unsure about rather than guess.

asks.q: Which office or department have you dealt with so far?
asks.hint: Even a rough answer narrows it. The block office, a bank, a school, a hospital.
asks.ph: Example: the electricity office in town

asks.q: What do you want them to do?
asks.hint: Fix something, pay something, or answer something.
asks.ph: Example: give me the certificate I applied for

identifiers.label: Any reference number you were given
identifiers.hint: From a receipt, an SMS or an acknowledgement. Skip it if there is none.

money.pension.label: Pension not received
money.pension.office: Pension Disbursing Bank, then the Pension Sanctioning Authority
money.pension.reason: A pension that has stopped is either the paying bank’s doing or the sanctioning office’s, and the PPO number tells us which.
money.pension.legal_basis: Central Civil Services (Pension) Rules; CPENGRAMS for central pensioners
money.pension.evidence: Your PPO copy or the last pension slip, if you have one.

identifiers.label: Your PPO number
identifiers.hint: On your pension payment order or your pension slip. It is not a bank account number.

identifiers.label: The office you retired from
identifiers.hint: Department and place.

identifiers.label: The last month you were paid
identifiers.hint: Approximate is fine.

asks.label: What stopped
asks.q: What happened with your pension — did it stop, or is it short?
asks.hint: And which month it last came.

asks.label: Who pays it
asks.q: Which bank or office pays your pension?
asks.hint: The branch name is enough.

none.label: No online route exists
none.note: Honest dead end. We hand over the CM helpline, pre-filled.

_asks_note: Per-domain follow-up questions, hand written. These are what a citizen sees when the model is unavailable or the spend ceiling has been reached, so they are written to be good on their own. The model improves on them by adapting to the citizen's own words and language; it does not rescue them.
